holds.candidate: STTGDC NOI2 at DLF Techpark Noida, Plot 1 Sector 143A
holds.reason: STTGDC's November 3 announcement supports completion of NOI2 on its existing campus. The Phase 2 filing confirms the plot and identifies the project as Block C Data Centre 2. The registration drawing labels the proposed buildings D and E for IT development; the C building is also identified as IT. The same plan identifies Block B as Data Centre in the separately registered first phase. The public filings have yet to tie an as-built, georeferenced building or a numeric campus reference to a verified STTGDC location independently of the entire mixed-use estate.
holds.evidence_pages: NOI2 operator release dated 2026-11-03; Phase II accountant certificate page 1; Phase II registered layout pages 1 and 2. The Oct 21 Neysa agreement concerns future deployment.
holds.identity: Baseline Noida sites are Sify 01, Sify 02, CtrlS, AdaniConneX and Yotta. No STTGDC Noida or DLF campus is represented. Operator groups NOI1/2/3 as one campus.
holds.reopen_condition: A corroborated original campus reference or georeferenced as-built drawing tied to the STTGDC host; actual workloads need a separate operating observation.

regulator_point_review.decision: The registry point for Phase 2 exactly matches the northern endpoint of the wider Plot 1 boundary printed in the first-phase accountant certificate. It locates the edge of the mixed-use estate and does not establish a location on the STTGDC campus.
